items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: It was the band I belonged to. I belonged to Man Peres band.

ctx.x: Did the golden rule have any special color? Blue or red or brown?

Yeah. Excelsior had a second uniform and the Man Peres band. The only two bands that had two uniforms was Man Peres and Excelsior. The Excelsior band was a band across the river and Man Peres was on this side. It was the band I belonged to. I belonged to Man Peres band. Yeah. Yeah.
Do you remember what the golden rule uniform looked like? Huh? Do you remember what the uniform looked like in the golden rule band? What they look like?
